label: 2026-10 official dry run
note: First run of the Phase 3 monthly-run pipeline. Both configurations use the task bank's scripted solvers, so identical scores across configurations are expected: this run validates the batch, ingestion, and reporting machinery, not agent quality. The pinned task parameters make the drawn instances identical across seeds for these seed tasks; seed variation exercises the run bookkeeping (n=3 per task, SPEC.md §6.2) rather than instance variety.
